skill.name: better-typography
skill.description: Focuses on type scale, spacing, sizing, variable fonts, OpenType features, wrapping, truncation and other details that make typography feel great across your product.
skill.summary: Review and improve web typography with consistent type scales, readable spacing, deliberate wrapping, and font features.
skill.author: jakubkrehel

security_audit.summary: All 51 static findings are false positives involving Markdown formatting, typography guidance, or a CSS selector. The review approval language applies to typography defects, not security adjudication. No evidence found of command execution, system reconnaissance, data exfiltration, or prompt injection in the reviewed files.

content.value_statement: Inconsistent sizes, cramped spacing, and hidden text make interfaces harder to read. This skill guides typography reviews and styling fixes using existing CSS or Tailwind conventions.
actual_capabilities: Guide role-based type scales, descending visual heading sizes, and readable line-height choices.
Recommend CSS declarations and Tailwind 4 equivalents for typography fixes.
Explain variable font axes, OpenType features, fallback behavior, and font synthesis checks.
Review wrapping, line length, truncation, and access to important hidden text.
Guide tabular numbers, mobile input sizing, underlines, selection, and mixed-direction text rendering.
Structure typography findings by severity, location, proposed change, and verification status.
limitations: Provides reference guidance, not an executable typography scanner or bundled browser automation.
Rendered wrapping and truncation require browser access and realistic content for verification.
Does not own copywriting, semantic heading structure, contrast classification, or spatial RTL layout.
Font features depend on the selected font, and newer CSS features require browser compatibility checks.

use_cases.title: Review Interface Typography
use_cases.description: Inspect dashboard headings, labels, and changing values, then propose fixes within the existing styling system.

use_cases.title: Define Shared Text Roles
use_cases.description: Create consistent text roles with coordinated size, weight, and line-height while preserving the product font family.

use_cases.title: Check Reading and Localization
use_cases.description: Review article line length, recoverable truncation, and mixed-direction text using realistic content and viewport sizes.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Text Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Review typography in [section or component]. Identify readability problems and suggest fixes without changing the font family or copy. State any unverified checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single text section.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Role-Based Type Scale
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [existing styles], propose display, title, heading, body, and caption roles. Specify size, weight, and line-height. Preserve the current font family and styling conventions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for shared typography tokens.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Wrapping and Truncation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [components] with [sample content] at mobile and desktop widths. Fix wrapping, long identifiers, and truncation in [styling system]. Keep important full values reachable.
prompt_templates.scenario: Applied review of content-dependent layout problems.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Font Behavior and Verification
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [application scope] for font synthesis, fallback emphasis, OpenType features, mobile inputs, and mixed-direction values. Group findings by principle and severity. Separate verified results from unavailable checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced typography audit across multiple components.

output_examples.input: A three-line card description uses the same tight line-height as its heading.
output: Finding: The description has insufficient spacing for multiline reading.
Recommendation: Use a line-height of at least 1.4 and retain the existing font family.
Verification: Check realistic descriptions at narrow widths and with larger browser text.

output_examples.input: A dashboard counter shifts horizontally whenever its digits change.
output: Finding: Proportional digits change the width of the displayed value.
Recommendation: Enable tabular numbers if the active font supports them.
Verification: Compare several digit combinations and confirm the layout remains stable.

output_examples.input: An Arabic interface displays a mixed-direction account identifier in the wrong order.
output: Finding: Adjacent text affects the ordering of the identifier.
Recommendation: Set language and direction at the appropriate boundary, and isolate the identifier with a bidirectional isolation element.
Verification: Check real Arabic and Latin values without manually reversing digits.

best_practices: Preserve the existing font family and implement changes through the project styling system.
Verify realistic content at multiple widths, with zoom, and across the fallback font stack.
Report findings by root cause and severity, and label checks that could not run as Not verified.
anti_patterns: Introduce a new or paid typeface solely to satisfy a typography checklist.
Hide important text through truncation without a way to access its full value.
Disable font synthesis globally before verifying required emphasis across fallback fonts.

faq.question: Does this skill require Tailwind?
faq.answer: No. It provides CSS declarations and Tailwind 4 equivalents. Apply the form that matches the existing project.

faq.question: Will it replace the product font?
faq.answer: Not by default. It instructs reviewers to preserve the existing font family unless the task explicitly requests a change.

faq.question: Does it include an automated scanner?
faq.answer: No. The package contains reference guidance and review instructions, not an executable scanner.

faq.question: Can typography be reviewed without a browser?
faq.answer: Styles can be inspected without one, but rendered wrapping and truncation need browser verification. Unavailable checks should be reported as Not verified.

faq.question: Does it perform a complete accessibility audit?
faq.answer: No. It addresses text rendering and readability. Semantic structure, contrast classification, and broader accessibility requirements are outside its scope.

faq.question: Do all fonts support the recommended features?
faq.answer: No. Variable axes and OpenType features depend on the font. Verify available features and fallback behavior before applying them.
